Description:en: A disposable filter cartridge used to remove waste products and excess fluid from blood during hemodialysis.
A sterile extracorporeal tubing set that carries blood between the patient and the dialysis machine during hemodialysis.
A cartridge containing bicarbonate powder or concentrate used to prepare bicarbonate-buffered dialysate for hemodialysis.
Sterile needles designed to cannulate an arteriovenous fistula or graft for hemodialysis.
Sterile devices with a barrel and plunger used to inject or withdraw fluids.
Sterile disposable gloves used to maintain aseptic technique during clinical procedures.
An absorbent woven or nonwoven medical material used for wound cleaning covering packing or absorption.
Single-use antiseptic swabs impregnated with alcohol or chlorhexidine for skin preparation.
A sterile transparent adhesive dressing used to cover and protect a wound or vascular access site while allowing visual inspection.
Adhesive tape intended to secure dressings tubing or other medical devices to the skin.
A puncture-resistant closable container used for the safe disposal of needles and other sharp medical items.
A designated bag used to collect and contain biomedical waste for safe handling and disposal.
